history.summary: Undo restores the exact previous graph, redo re-applies it, a new command clears redo.
With the session history empty, undo restores the previous stored revision as a new one.
toRevision restores that stored revision as a new head and clears the session history.
A refused command leaves the graph and the history untouched.
